book.name: 1 Qorontoosa Kiita
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoosa Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Geeshsha Ayyaana Imotata
Ta ishato, Geeshsha Ayyaana imotataba hinte erana mela ta koyas.
Hinte Xoossaa ammanonna wode dooni bayna eeqatan gooshetidi, hinte eronna soo bidaysa ereeta.
Xoossaa Ayyaanay kaalethiya asi oonika, “Yesuusi baadeto” yaagenna. Qassi Geeshsha Ayyaanay kaalethonna de7ishin, oonika, “Yesuusi Godaa” gaanaw danda7onaysa hinte erana mela koyayis.
Dumma dumma Ayyaana imotati de7oosona, shin imotata immiya Ayyaanay issuwa.
Nu Godaas oothiya dumma dumma oosoti de7oosona, shin Goday issuwa.
Nu Godaas oothiya dumma dumma ogeti de7oosona, shin he ogetan oothiya asa ubban oothiya Xoossay issuwa.
Shin issuwas issuwas imetida imotatan harata maaddana mela Geeshsha Ayyaanay qoncees.
Geeshsha Ayyaanay issuwas cincatethi kumida qaala immees; qassi issuwas eratethi kumida qaala immees.
He Geeshsha Ayyaanay issuwas ammano, hankuwas qassi pathiya wolqaa immees.

Geeshsha Ayyaanay issuwas malaata oothiya wolqaa, issuwas tinbite odiya wolqaa immees. Issuwas ayyaanape ayyaana shaaki eriya wolqaa, issuwas dumma dumma doonan odiya wolqaa, qassi issuwas dumma dumma doonan odetidaysa birshiya wolqaa immees.
Shin ha ubbaa oothey he issi Geeshsha Ayyaana. I koyiya mela issi issi asaas dumma dumma imota immees.
Asatethinne Billiteta
Issi asatethan daro billiteti de7oosona, shin he dumma dumma billiteti issi asatethi gidoosona. Hessadaka, Kiristoosi dumma dumma billiteti de7iya asatethaa mela.
Nuuni Ayhude gidin Girike gidin aylle gidin womaanno gidin, ubbay issi asatethi gidanaw Geeshsha Ayyaanan xammaqetida. Qassi nu ubbay issi Geeshsha Ayyaana ekida.
Nu asatethan dumma dumma billiteti de7oosonape attishin, issi billite gidenna.
Tohoy, “Taani kushe gidonna gisho billite gidike” giiko, I hessa gida gisho billitetethay attiyee?
Haythi, “Taani ayfe gidonna gisho billite gidike” giiko, I hessa gida gisho asatethafe issi billite gideysi attiyee?
Asatetha ubbay ayfe xalaala gididaako, nu aybin si7anee? Qassi asatethi ubbay haytha xalaala gididaako nu aybin singanee?
Shin Xoossay ba koydaysada, asatethaa giddon dumma dumma billiteta wothis.
Ubbay issi billite gididaako asatethi waanidi daanee?
Shin billiteti daro gidikoka, asatethay issuwa.
Ayfey kusheko, “Ne taw koshshaka” gaanaw danda7enna. Woyko huuphey tohoko, “Ne taw koshshaka” gaanaw danda7enna.
Shin daabura daaniya asatethaa billiteti nuus aadhidi koshshosona.
Boncho koshshenna gidi nu qopiya nu billitetape baggata daro bonchoos. Qassi nu borsetiya nu asatethaa billiteta aathidi bonchidi naagoos.
Nu be7in borsonna asatethaa billitetas boncho koshshenna. Shin Xoossay nu asatethaa billiteta wolira gasethidi borsiya billitetas aadhiya boncho immis.
Asatetha billiteti issoy issuwara shaako medhonna wolis qopana mela oothidi medhis.
Asatetha billitetape issoy saketiko billiteti ubbay iyara saketoosona. Asatetha billitetape issoy bonchetiko billiteti ubbay iyara ufaytoosona.
Hinte ubbay Kiristoosa asatethi; qassi hinte issoy issoy iya billiteta.

Woosa keethan Xoossay, koyro hawaareta, nam7antho nabeta, heedzantho astamaareta, kaallidi malaata ootheyisata, patheyisata, harata maaddeyisata, woosa keetha ayseysatanne, dumma dumma doonan odeteyisata wothis.
Ubbay hawaaree? Ubbay nabee? Ubbay astamaaree? Ubbay malaata oothii?
Ubbay pathiyee? Ubbay dumma dumma doonan odeetii? Ubbay dumma dumma doonan odetoysa birshii?
Shin ubbaafe aadhiya imota minthidi koyite. Qassi ubbaafe aadhiya ogiya ta hintena bessaana.
